items.item: 1. The breadth of a life's reach (Fable 2.1 and hole 1)
items.how: 07's definition sentence is unchanged at both sites. Added right after it, in the thesis and in section 4's opening, word for word as the fronts have it: 'A life's reach, along being affected, holds everything that can affect its continuation at some remove: what sustains it and what draws on the same conditions alike.' (Flow.AffectedBy g h := ∃ c, W.DependsOn g c ∧ L.Exchanges h c, so a giver to and a taker from a condition the life depends on both affect it; Flow.WithinInfluence is its closure). Which relation is a reading: in the thesis, 'What the represented dynamics leave open is which relation, or which class, is a center's own.' -> '... is a center's own: along feeding, narrower than being affected, the condition can fail where relations of being affected close, and a listed item beyond a center's reach parts self-concern from being increasing in admission ([§4](#scope-and-order)).'; at the end of section 4's opening paragraph (after the scope-order sentence, so no quoted span is split), new: 'Which relation a life's reach runs along is a reading ([§1](#what-forms-and-what-is-supplied)); along being affected it is the influence closure (`Flow.WithinInfluence`, the closure of `Flow.AffectedBy`). Along a narrower relation a listed item can lie beyond what a center's line reaches, and then some self-concerned order, its marking reading only that reach, is not increasing in admission (`Weighting.exists_increasingInOwn_not_increasing_of_outside`). Along feeding the condition can fail where it holds along being affected: in a balanced pair each taking from the condition the other depends on, with nothing given, the pair is mutually dependent and neither feeds the other (`Drawing.mutual_not_fed`, [05](05-COLLECTIVES.md#r-mutual-dependence-and-its-pace)), and the condition held de se at them holds along being affected and not along feeding (`Drawing.returning_feeding_apart`).' Each clause is the Lean's: the witness's hypothesis `within` (own marks only what the line reaches) and conclusion (∃ O, IncreasingInOwn ∧ ¬ Increasing); mutual_not_fed (Balances ∧ MutuallyDependent ∧ neither within the other's feeding closure); returning_feeding_apart (at the returning formations, Unrestricted along Affects and AffectedBy, not along FedFrom). 05 names the pair only as 'a pair with nothing given', so the Lean name is cited with 05's anchor. Quotes moved with the inserted sentence: navigation.OPEN_LEAD['life'] (the reach sentence between the definition and 'That a life forms'), PHILOSOPHY.md:143's quotation of 07 section 4. The same sentence was added after the definition in 08 section 2 (after '(`Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing_of_unrestricted`).', as the first screen places it), ONE-ARGUMENT.md:94 and COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION.md:30, so the homes and pages that state the hinge say its breadth as the fronts now do; their revision lines say so.
